title: Guidance-Induced Activation of Score Estimation Errors in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28451v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) combines conditional and unconditional score estimates to steer diffusion sampling. The weighted-solenoidal component of each score error has no instantaneous effect on the evolution of its corresponding reference density. Because the guided density in CFG generally differs from both reference densities, the combination of these solenoidal components can affect the evolution of the guided marginals. We call this mechanism guidance-induced error activation. Using a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition, we identify the activated error field, quantify its magnitude, and characterize when it vanishes. At fixed noise time, the activated error field varies continuously with guidance strength. Its weak first-order variation has two terms, one from reweighting the errors and one from the change in the guided density. translated_title: 扩散模型中引导诱导的分数估计误差激活
translated_abstract: 无分类器引导（Classifier-free guidance, CFG）通过组合条件与无条件分数估计来引导扩散采样。每个分数误差的加权螺线分量对其相应参考密度的演化没有瞬时影响。然而，由于CFG中的引导密度通常与两个参考密度均不相同，这些螺线分量的组合可能会影响引导边缘分布的演化。我们将这一机制称为“引导诱导的误差激活”。利用加权Helmholtz-Hodge分解，我们识别了被激活的误差场，量化了其大小，并刻画了其消失的条件。在固定噪声时间下，激活的误差场随引导强度连续变化，其弱一阶变化包含两项：一项来自误差的重新加权，另一项来自引导密度的变化。对于有限的分数误差，ODE特征线方法与SDE的Feynman-Kac公式将误差激活…（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了CFG中的“引导诱导误差激活”机制：通过加权Helmholtz-Hodge分解，识别并量化了原本对参考密度无瞬时影响的螺线型score误差分量如何因引导密度与参考密度的差异而影响引导采样的边缘分布演化。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies and quantifies "guidance-induced error activation" in classifier-free guidance, using a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition to show how solenoidal score error components—harmless to their reference densities—affect the evolution of guided marginals.
